title: [Quality Management] UI actions to restore default shipped source configurations
summary: Quality Management adds UI actions to restore, reset, or recreate default source configurations and makes the configuration card page editable to help resolve incomplete or damaged setup states.
key_points: Card page becomes editable for direct configuration changes
Reset default configuration action on card page to discard customizations
Three new list page actions: recreate missing defaults, reset only defaults while preserving custom ones, and reset all configurations
Helps resolve environments stuck with incomplete or damaged source configurations
quote: Adds options to unstuck environment from incomplete or damaged source configurations
